name: face-2-happy
prompt: Generate an image. The reference is my game character, a grumpy cheese crab with a cabbage-leaf shell (Crabbage). Draw THIS SAME character as a cartoon story portrait showing a strong, funny, very readable emotion: laughing with joy: eyes squeezed into happy arcs, a huge open-mouthed grin, bouncing with delight, little sparkles around it. IMPORTANT BODY RULE: Crabbage has exactly TWO big claws (both raised at the sides) and a few short pointed crab legs, NO third claw at the bottom, exactly like the reference. Never add extra claws, arms or hands. Show the emotion with the face, the eye stalks and the pose of those two claws. Keep it EXACTLY on-model: same body shape and proportions, same colours, same face design, same thick dark outlines and glossy cel shading as the reference. Do not add any clothes, props, extra limbs or extra characters that are not in the reference. Same three-quarter view and facing direction as the reference, whole body visible, centred, filling about 85% of the frame. Solid flat magenta (#FF00FF) background, no shadow, no text. Portrait 4:5 image.
